text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day off, while out shopping—
choice_data_list: Huh? Dantsu?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer...? Ah, it is you!
Ehehe,
what a coincidence.
Are you out doing something today?
choice_data_list: Just some shopping. What about you?
Just some shopping. What about you?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um... I was just thinking of checking out
that specialty cheesecake shop that just
opened.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It was originally super popular over in the
Kansai region.
They even have a Tokyo-exclusive menu item,
so I'm really looking forward to it!
choice_data_list: Oh, super popular in Kansai? Sound...
Oh, super popular in Kansai? Sound...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's supposed to be incredible~!
The one I'm most curious about is...
Oh! Ah! I'm sorry,
I'm just babbling on and on...!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, have a good time shopping!
I'm sorry for holding you up!
choice_data_list: Not at all. I'm curious too, mind ...
Not at all. I'm curious too, mind ...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh?! I-Is that... really okay...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking the chance to try the new item,
a light,
fluffy sweetness spreads across my palate.
Its unprecedented tenderness keeps my fork
moving without pause.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the treat. And you,
Trainer... Ah, you cleaned your plate!
Was it good?
choice_data_list: Yeah! It was delicious!
Yes! It was delicious!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, it was brought out just a moment ago,
but...
we both devoured it in no time flat.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I ended up dragging you along all of a sudden,
so...
I'm really glad you enjoyed it~.
choice_data_list: How was yours, Dantsu?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Of course it was amazing!
It was so good my cheeks could've melted off—
I'm so happy!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but you still have shopping to do,
right? Let's head out!
Heading home feeling like this... ehehe,
it's pure bliss.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Haaah,
that was so satisfying...♪ Today was my
treat-myself day, so
I'll work extra hard in training starting
next week!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wait, huh? ...Come to think of it,
isn't this—
choice_data_list: What's wrong?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, it's nothing! Um...
I just thought this area looked like the
setting of one of my favorite movies—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it definitely is! Ehehe...
I've watched it so many times that I've
memorized the scenery.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!
Which means the filming location for THAT
scene is close by too!
choice_data_list: That scene?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The iconic scene that you simply can't
leave out
when talking about that movie!
It seems to be right around here!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I still have some time,
so... maybe I'll drop by.
Trainer, I'll take my leave here—
choice_data_list: Mind if I come along to see it too?
Mind if I come along to see it too?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?! B-But... first the cake,
and now this...
Are you sure you want to spend the whole
day doing what I want?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...A-Are you... really sure...?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wh—! ...There's nothing here!!
...Well,
I guess that makes sense...
It is just an underpass, after all.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but...
that pillar!
That's the one from that passionate
scene—!
choice_data_list: What kind of passionate scene?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The main character screams out all her
feelings for the other girls right at that
pillar!
Vowing that she's definitely going to take
back center stage!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh—um,
it's a movie about a cheerleading club.
There's a scene where they spend all summer
practicing under that pillar.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
She feels like everyone else is shining so
much brighter than her.
But she refuses to give up!
It's when those feelings boil over that she
shouts—
choice_data_list: Sounds a lot like you, Dantsu.
Sounds a lot like you, Dantsu.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...I do look up to her, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's a secret,
but... whenever I'm alone in my dorm room,
I sometimes practice imitating her in front
of the mirror...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Like softly shouting her line:
"I'm definitely gonna become the star of
the show!!"

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Or reenacting the scene where she throws
her phone while crying out her feelings.
Ah, but of course,
I throw mine onto the bed...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Man,
now I really want to watch that movie
again.
Maybe I'll go rent it later.
choice_data_list: Rent it? It's not streaming anywhere?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It's an older movie,
so most streaming sites don't have it.
You have to rent a physical copy from a
rental shop.
choice_data_list: In that case, let's go rent it tog...
In that case, let's go rent it tog...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...! Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Well then... um.
L-Let's go... together!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so...
Dantsu Flame and I watched the movie together
in the Trainer's office.
The young cheerleader's burning passion
struck a deep chord—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
*sniffle*... Oh,
man...
No matter how many times I watch this
ending...
choice_data_list: Man... that really hits right in t...
Man... that really hits right in t...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!!
Right?! Isn't it amazing?! Ugh,
it makes me cry every single time—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...And afterwards,
it just makes you want to look forward
again.
Like having a good cry empties out your head
so you can start fresh.
choice_data_list: You really love this movie, don't you?
You really love this movie, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I do.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
it's felt like such a magical day...
Eating cheesecake,
visiting where the movie was filmed,
watching it together...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but um... thinking back on it all,
I dragged you along to
nothing but my own personal things,
and I'm really sorry about that...!
choice_data_list: Don't be. I had a great time today...
Don't be. I had a great time today...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I smile at her blank,
surprised expression and continue.
Her favorite food, a place dear to her heart,
the movie that gives her strength—
choice_data_list: I loved getting to know more about...
I loved getting to know more about...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...It's true. Today...
I dragged my Trainer all over the place,
and yet...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(So many of the things that make up who I
am...
All the things I love,
all the things precious to me...
they got to see them all—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Next time... would you let me come along
with you for your favorite things too?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
It could be anything! Movies, music,
books,
or um, even video games,
I'm totally down for whatever...!!
choice_data_list: ...You don't need to worry about p...
...You don't need to worry about p...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Oh, no! That's not it,
this isn't about paying you back!
It's just that I want to learn more about
you too, Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Pigtails Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
“...Hey! Next time,
you gotta tell me your recommendations,
Dantsu!
I'll do whatever you want to return the
favor!”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“Huh? No, it's fine,
really!
Don't worry about paying me back...!”

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh. Maybe she was feeling...
the exact same way I'm feeling right
now...?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: I was being so dense...
choice_data_list: ...Did you figure something import...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! I'm sorry Trainer, I have to go!
Let's talk about what I said earlier again...
another time!

text_block_list.name: Pigtails Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Huh, a cheesecake place recommended by
Dantsu?!
Ooh, I wanna go,
I wanna go! You're inviting me?!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Yup! I tried it for the first time today,
and I fell totally in love with it...
I was thinking I'd love to go again next
weekend.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
So, if you'd like to...
I'd love for you to join me.
For something I really love.
